guide.summary: A dimly lit pool with two leaf wafers in baskets and a patch of mesh between them.
guide.biology: Leaves that fall into still water feed it slowly for a long time, and surfaces near them give attached life somewhere to hold on.
guide.rules: All water; no stones. Light 0.6, warmth 0.5, oxygen 0.8, carbon dioxide 0.5, nutrient 0.10 and sugar 0.02 in every cell. A nutrient basket holding a leaf wafer at (45,64) and at (80,64): each wafer starts with 6 starch carbon, 4 protein carbon and 1 bound nutrient and lets them out into its own cell over about 500 seconds. An attachment mesh covers a circle of radius 8 at (64,64). Lid open; fixed light.
guide.example: Start it empty and watch what gathers at each wafer as it empties.
